s: GDP according to income method is measured through
o: Domestic factor incomes plus Net Income from aboard
Domestic factor incomes minus Transfer payments
x:
Printed key and old notes: domestic factor incomes minus transfer payments. Strictly: GDP by the income method = sum of domestic factor incomes; transfers are simply excluded (NCERT Class 12 Macroeconomics ch.2).
Under the income method GDP (domestic product) is the sum of factor incomes earned within the domestic territory (wages, rent, interest, profit, mixed income), with depreciation added for the gross figure; adding NFIA gives a national, not domestic, aggregate. Transfer payments are never part of factor incomes, so 'minus transfer payments' is not a step of the method.

x: From Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean: Mode − Mean = 3(Median − Mean), which is option 4. Option 3 (Mode − Median = 2(Median − Mean)) is the same identity rearranged, so it is also true; options 1 and 2 are false.

s: Chi square distribution is a ............ distribution
x:
Key: asymmetric. More precisely: positively (right) skewed (option 3), which is also true.
The chi-square distribution is asymmetric: it is skewed to the right (positively skewed) and becomes nearly symmetric only for large degrees of freedom. Option 1 is the key, and option 3 says the same thing more precisely.
